title: Batch or continuous?
caption: Continuous processes suit very large volumes of a single product made all the time (ammonia, sulfuric acid, petrol). Batch processes suit smaller amounts of many products, made in turn in the same equipment (pharmaceuticals, dyes, flavours).
alt: A tree: is a large volume of one product needed continuously? Continuous. Otherwise: batch.
description: Large, steady demand for one product: continuous, such as ammonia.
Smaller amounts or many products: batch, such as medicines.

q.q: Is a very large volume of one product needed all the time?
